svg.title: Eventiva layer 3, group 2
svg.desc: Prerequisite arrows point toward dependent issues. Layers are derived, not approved dates. Labels and border patterns distinguish completed, current, upcoming, closed and blocked work. Every node links to its live issue; Markdown provides full titles, prerequisites and unlocks.
svg.text: Derived layers; not deadlines or acceptance.
Blocked overrides fill/border; current keeps double.

a.aria-label: EVE-103: F6.2 Build locations and the append-only stock movement ledger. UPCOMING / BLOCKED. Captured Linear: Backlog. 2026-11-18: later-status: Owner-relayed revision-10 physical location metadata slice: four sensitive online-only actions, existing default-off inventory flag, immutable kinds and revisioned parent/name under tenant graph guard. Focused actual PostgreSQL/SQLite host proof passes 13 tests including reopen, paging/root filters, history/replay, bounded complete ancestry, rollback/interruption/recovery and live policy. Independent PostgreSQL client races isolate the graph lock from unrelated identity serialization; reverse/disjoint cycles have one winner, and deliberately bypassing guard CAS yields two winners. Latest-main full gates and signed delivery are recorded separately on the live issue/timeline. No stock/ledger/archive authority, Resources/SQL/compiler API, dependency or production activation. Broader EVE-103 remains Backlog/open; frozen capture is unchanged. EVE-248 stays January 2027 only. Sources: https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-103#comment-ddd54a8f-bada-472f-a508-6c5cce1998e5, https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a1e940-37a3-7691-a5c0-e935b711c99a. 5 prerequisites; 4 unlocks. Layer 3.
